integrity: The proof combines the published type-D Weyl-orbit realization with the standard parity-polytope H-description, computes exact distances to both facet orbits, proves incenter uniqueness from opposite coordinate facets, and uses uniqueness plus Weyl invariance to determine both John and Löwner ellipsoids. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical type-D spin fundamental-weight normalization for n>=4. It does not cover other fundamental weights, arbitrary affine images, or non-Euclidean norms. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent observation in parity-polytope or coding-theory terminology.
title: Exact John–Löwner ellipsoids of type-D spin weight polytopes
